profile.headline: Ex-Microsoft | SWE
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Born and raised in Honduras until the age of ten years old, I could have never anticipated living in the USA nor having the exposure or opportunity to learn about the vast world of technology. As a child, thinking of owning my own laptop was more than I could have hoped for, let alone becoming a US citizen, graduating with a degree in computer information systems, and becoming skillful in multiple coding languages. My curiosity for computers started playfully and naturally when I created a frame-by-frame animation of a moving vehicle using “Paint” and “Windows Movie Maker” on a Windows 98 desktop computer. Despite the language barrier, I quickly figured out how to use the computer and started becoming more curious to know how it functioned. It was around that age that I realized my future revolved around technology.
In middle school I was very active in extracurricular activities. I joined a LEGO robotics team, Ridder Kids and caught a glimpse of what it means to program. Attending Bronx High School of Computers & Technology is where my interest in robotics grew. I joined and competed at the FIRST Robotics Competition (which is a larger scale comparing to the LEGO robotics), where my team and I built actual robots with circuit boards. I grew more fascinated and interested in solving problems while using my creativity in the process.
After getting my Bachelor’s degree, I had the opportunity to further strengthen my knowledge in programming at The Tech Academy's Software Developer Coding Bootcamp. I was able to apply what I learned in several projects I contributed to during my internship at Prosper IT Consulting.
Like technology, I have grown beyond what I could have imagined I'd become. I have learned that technology can be used to help people and to help the world. My passion and creativity have been recognized by colleagues in the tech industry. I'm overjoyed and eager to use my knowledge in my future career.

- Nov 2019

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: 11 Times Sq, New York, NY 10036 · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Leveraged LLM-powered agentic workflows using GitHub Copilot CLI to accelerate automation development, reducing delivery time for a representative project from 20 days to 2 days.
• Maintained orchestrated Azure Synapse pipelines that processed more than 2 billion rows (1 TB) daily, generating Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS) files used to deliver policy and user metrics from Microsoft Teams customers.
• Designed an automated Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery (BCDR) strategy for critical sovereign Synapse Workspaces, mirroring artifact deployments to ensure continuous availability for on-demand workloads.
• Led the development and maintenance of troubleshooting tools written in C# and Typescript/React.js made available to an organization of approximately 100 employees, enabling diagnosis of issues affecting Microsoft Teams’ global user base of over 320 million active users.
• Led infrastructure provisioning and Azure DevOps CI/CD pipeline development for 5 sovereign cloud projects, enabling reliable deployments across specialized environments.
• Strengthened service security and privacy compliance by continuously updating permissions for a production service and implementing data access controls aligned with EU Data Boundary (EUDB) requirements.
• Migrated Azure resource deployment definitions to a C# Infrastructure as Code (IaC) framework, enabling scalable, reusable deployments across multiple environments.
positions.insights: Skills: Critical Thinking · Microsoft Azure · C# · Software Design

positions.title: Sofware Engineer
positions.locationName: 3940 159th Ave NE, Redmond, WA 98052 Microsoft Building 35
positions.description:
• Collaborated with the IC3 Records Distribution team to help diagnose Microsoft Teams & Skype for Business calls during COVID-19.
• Created a Design document leveraging Microsoft Visio to create wireframes and flow diagrams for software design.
• Wrote unit tests following test driven development approach in REACT.js and C# .NET.
• Deployed an app using Azure Web App services applying Azure Active Directory authentication.
• Learned to create and edit ARM (Azure Resource Management) templates to make deployments. 
• Contributed to a C# API applying logic for data obfuscation.
positions.insights: Skills: Critical Thinking · Microsoft Azure · C# · Software Design

positions.title: Release Management Engineer
positions.locationName: 300 Main Street Suite 4-202, East Rochester NY, 14445
positions.description:
• Managed and deployed testing, performance, and production releases for SiriusXM-Pandora radio applications using Linux and Docker technologies in the Identity Management (IDM) department.
• Monitored company servers and worked with a team to optimize performance.
• Developed a Python graphical user interface that automates configuration processes for deploying services for the team to use.
• Communicated design, requirements, feature set, functionality and limitations of systems/applications to team and development leaders.
• Provided application performance monitoring and tuning for improvements.
• Collaborated with multiple technical teams to troubleshoot service releases.
positions.insights: Skills: Critical Thinking · C# · Software Design

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Worked within the Agile Methodology such as Scrum in 4 projects with 4 different teams of developers, each project consisting of 2-week sprints.
• Collaborated with teams of developers in projects utilizing Git and Azure DevOps version control systems.
• Contributed to a C# (ASP.NET MVC) web application that facilitates and automates the ability for admin users to assign jobs to employees by personally implementing a feature that allows tasks to be added to specific jobs. 
• Utilized Entity Framework Code First and SQL in the execution of this project.
• Created a web application using Python (Django) that allows users to search low-fare flights across U.S. airports by filling out a dynamically populated form. Ultimately, users get a response containing real-time data from developers.amadeus.com API requests.
• Developed login, logout, register, and authentication logic to a web application using Python (Django).
• Learned to quickly adapt to unfamiliar technologies and to utilize technical terminologies in clever ways to explain concepts, thus facilitating communication between teammates.
positions.insights: Skills: Critical Thinking · C# · Software Design

positions.title: Bilingual Youth Specialist
positions.description:
• Provided emergency counseling, initial case management, translated (English to Spanish and vise-versa) during day to day supervision.
• Monitored and documented reports of Unaccompanied Alien Children (UAC) sent to the UAC shelter.
• Transported youth to several locations such as school, medical appointments, recreational facilities, chapel etc.
• Communicated proficiently with children while providing a safety in an educational environment.

positions.title: Technical Support Agent Level 2
positions.description:
• Managed a high volume of national and international calls with customers professionally.
• Troubleshooted, diagnosed, and resolved a range of software, hardware, and connectivity issues.
• Excelled in communicating, research, and analyzing to rectify problems with several clients and client’s customers.
• Partnered with Tier 1 and 3 peers to resolve complex problems.
• Provided detailed description of issues using the several ticketing systems and followed up diligently to ensure swift resolutions.
positions.insights: Skills: Critical Thinking · Computer Network Operations

• Monitored children in recreation.
• Supervised junior counselors and maintained student records.
